label: TEST-ORACLE INTERNAL DIAGNOSTIC
interpretation: Three probe seeds, not three independently trained backbones. Test-selected probe epochs are internal diagnostics, not independent generalization.

probe_capacity.caveat: Approximately capacity-matched heads; frozen random 512-to-64 per-slot projection is a bottleneck. Null probe gains do not establish absence of information in memory.

sign_caveat: Sign metrics for historical and difference score targets are not current sentiment classification or evidence of relational reasoning.

macro_definition.weighting: equal rate weight, then probe seed mean/sample SD

bootstrap.unit: conversation within each rate; no pooled-rate confidence intervals
